reason: Neutral locators (PDF p. 9 / printed p. 806 and the self vs. other transgression fairness comparison excluding altruists) uniquely identify the Experiment 1 Hypothesis 2 contrast excluding altruists. The authors explicitly state in Table 1 (p. 804) that Hypothesis 2 was not supported in Experiment 1 and conclude in the Discussion (p. 811) that when only transgressors were included (altruists excluded), participants did not rate themselves as more moral than others, confirming 'failed' for this specific effect.
